The 24-hour horizon is a next-day daily-demand proxy, not an hourly forecast.
SMA7 and WMA7 use only seven prior daily observations and do not model promotions or external factors.
ABC demand value uses synthetic price and demand; it is not financial valuation of real inventory.
WMA7 weights are fixed before evaluation and are not tuned on the 14-day test window.
